@leonluc-dev this proposal is approved. Are you interested in providing the implementation? If so, we may do that after two weeks or so after we fork `main` branch.

Yes, this can be implemented this way but may be we can optimize it a little by using [GetEquivalentDateTime](https://source.dot.net/System.Private.CoreLib/R/883acf5f04e6d569.html)(). 

```C#
public static int GetWeekOfYear(DateOnly date) => GetWeekOfYear(date.GetEquivalentDateTime());
```

Of course, we'll need to make [GetEquivalentDateTime](https://source.dot.net/System.Private.CoreLib/R/883acf5f04e6d569.html)() `internal` instead of `private`. 

As I mentioned we need to open the PR later, after two weeks or we can open it now as a draft and then we can merge it later. Please let me know what works best for you.
